context: Prevalence of potentially neuropathic Campylobacter jejuni strains on commercial broiler chicken products. Campylobacteriosis is the most common antecedent infection leading to the development of inflammatory neuropathies including Guillain Barré syndrome (GBS) and Miller Fisher syndrome (MFS), with alterations in surface proteins and genetic polymorphisms conferring increased risk.
target: Poultry is the most common source of C.
